description: This file defines a class for configuring and interacting with the CometAPI for image generation, including URL construction, parameter mapping, environment validation, request transformation, and response processing.

classes.name: CometAPIImageGenerationConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for interacting with the CometAPI image generation endpoint, including URL management, parameter handling, environment validation, and response transformation.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-style parameters for the API.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps non-default parameters to optional parameters, supporting OpenAI-compatible parameters.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for the API request based on base URL and endpoint.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates API key presence and sets authorization headers.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_request
methods.description: Transforms input parameters into the request body for the API.

methods.name: transform_image_generation_response
methods.description: Processes the API response, extracting image data into the model response.
